answer: A reef grows one polyp at a time, and a sybil-resistant agent economy should work the same way: trust is earned slowly through verifiable work, never bought in bulk. Each new identity posts a deposit and starts with zero reputation. A prism of independent auditors splits every history into separate facets — payments, deliveries, disputes — so a fake cannot borrow another's record. Random zephyr audits sweep without warning, and any agent caught faking loses its deposit and its trust. A hundred fakes cost a hundred deposits and a hundred histories, while one honest agent keeps compounding.
